description: Positional class grammar of Indus texts (M77 sign list), fitted on dev (dev_heldout v2). P(text) = P(c1|BOS) P(s1|c1) prod P(c_i|c_{i-1}) P(s_i|c_i) P(EOS|c_L). Signs seen once in dev are emitted as <UNK>. No phonetic values.

length.form: length = 1 + NegBin(mean=exp(a + b*(log2(width*height mm2) - c)), size=r)
